vllm/model_executor/layers/rotary_embedd._triton_mrope_forward:
def _triton_mrope_forward(
    q_ptr,
    k_ptr,
    cos,
    sin,
    num_tokens,
    n_qh: tl.constexpr,
    n_kh: tl.constexpr,
    hd: tl.constexpr,
    rd: tl.constexpr,
    pad_n_qh: tl.constexpr,
    pad_n_kh: tl.constexpr,
    pad_hd: tl.constexpr,
    mrope_section_t: tl.constexpr,
    mrope_section_h: tl.constexpr,
    mrope_section_w: tl.constexpr,
    is_interleaved: tl.constexpr,
):
    # cos/sin have shape (3, num_tokens, rd // 2), laid out contiguously.
    pid = tl.program_id(0)
    q_ptr = q_ptr + pid * (n_qh * hd)
    k_ptr = k_ptr + pid * (n_kh * hd)

    half_rd = rd // 2
    t_end = mrope_section_t
    h_end = t_end + mrope_section_h

    t_cos = cos + pid * half_rd
    h_cos = t_cos + num_tokens * half_rd
    w_cos = h_cos + num_tokens * half_rd
    t_sin = sin + pid * half_rd
    h_sin = t_sin + num_tokens * half_rd
    w_sin = h_sin + num_tokens * half_rd

    cos_offsets = tl.arange(0, pad_hd // 2)
    cos_mask = cos_offsets < half_rd

    if is_interleaved:
        mod3 = cos_offsets % 3
        t_mask = cos_mask & ((cos_offsets < t_end * 3) & (mod3 == 0))
        h_mask = cos_mask & ((cos_offsets < mrope_section_h * 3) & (mod3 == 1))
        w_mask = cos_mask & ((cos_offsets < mrope_section_w * 3) & (mod3 == 2))
    else:
        t_mask = cos_mask & (cos_offsets < t_end)
        h_mask = cos_mask & ((t_end <= cos_offsets) & (cos_offsets < h_end))
        w_mask = cos_mask & ((h_end <= cos_offsets) & (cos_offsets < half_rd))

    t_cos_row = tl.load(t_cos + cos_offsets, mask=t_mask, other=0)
    h_cos_row = tl.load(h_cos + cos_offsets, mask=h_mask, other=0)
    w_cos_row = tl.load(w_cos + cos_offsets, mask=w_mask, other=0)
    t_sin_row = tl.load(t_sin + cos_offsets, mask=t_mask, other=0)
    h_sin_row = tl.load(h_sin + cos_offsets, mask=h_mask, other=0)
    w_sin_row = tl.load(w_sin + cos_offsets, mask=w_mask, other=0)

    cos_row = t_cos_row + h_cos_row + w_cos_row
    sin_row = t_sin_row + h_sin_row + w_sin_row

    first_half_offsets = tl.arange(0, pad_hd // 2)
    q_left_offsets = tl.arange(0, pad_n_qh)[:, None] * hd + first_half_offsets[None, :]
    k_left_offsets = tl.arange(0, pad_n_kh)[:, None] * hd + first_half_offsets[None, :]
    q_left_mask = (tl.arange(0, pad_n_qh)[:, None] < n_qh) & (first_half_offsets[None, :] < half_rd)
    k_left_mask = (tl.arange(0, pad_n_kh)[:, None] < n_kh) & (first_half_offsets[None, :] < half_rd)

    q_tile_1 = tl.load(q_ptr + q_left_offsets, mask=q_left_mask, other=0).to(sin_row.dtype)
    k_tile_1 = tl.load(k_ptr + k_left_offsets, mask=k_left_mask, other=0).to(sin_row.dtype)

    q_right_offsets = q_left_offsets + half_rd
    k_right_offsets = k_left_offsets + half_rd
    q_tile_2 = tl.load(q_ptr + q_right_offsets, mask=q_left_mask, other=0).to(sin_row.dtype)
    k_tile_2 = tl.load(k_ptr + k_right_offsets, mask=k_left_mask, other=0).to(sin_row.dtype)

    new_q_tile_1 = q_tile_1 * cos_row - q_tile_2 * sin_row
    new_q_tile_2 = q_tile_2 * cos_row + q_tile_1 * sin_row
    new_k_tile_1 = k_tile_1 * cos_row - k_tile_2 * sin_row
    new_k_tile_2 = k_tile_2 * cos_row + k_tile_1 * sin_row

    tl.store(q_ptr + q_left_offsets, new_q_tile_1, mask=q_left_mask)
    tl.store(q_ptr + q_right_offsets, new_q_tile_2, mask=q_left_mask)
    tl.store(k_ptr + k_left_offsets, new_k_tile_1, mask=k_left_mask)
    tl.store(k_ptr + k_right_offsets, new_k_tile_2, mask=k_left_mask)
